children: Sweden industrial group Volati Q3 net sales rose 12% yr/yr, driven by acquisitions
Company completed two add-on acquisitions during the quarter
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook commentary for future quarters or full year in its press release
ACQUISITIONS - Co said net sales growth was driven by acquisitions completed during the year
UNDERLYING EARNINGS - Co reported improved underlying EBITA margin before items affecting comparability
PLATFORM EXPANSION - Add-on acquisitions broadened offerings in label and moisture control markets
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the consumer goods conglomerates peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Volati AB is SEK32.50, about 31.3% above its October 22 closing price of SEK24.75
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
